name: Space-3D
license: Unlicense; included classic noise is MIT
integration: The original GLSL files are preserved byte for byte.
library-nebula.jsx splits the upstream stage markers and expands its noise include for Three.js.
The adapter removes the GLSL 100 directive for Three.js WebGL2 and initializes the upstream uninitialized displacement vector to zero.
Existing Drei Environment and RenderTexture compose the photo and nebula with a separate wide lens. Sky rotation and stellar orbits use elapsed scene time, not pointer input.
Colour, density, panorama framing and brightness are integration parameters; no AI-generated image or new effect shader is used.
